scope: Offline verified restore installation, state/path transformation, credential invalidation, index rebuild, interrupted-install rollback and startup fencing; hardened deployment acceptance remains open
checks: Install requires a retained exclusive root lease; the real lock still excludes another process at every injected installation boundary.

All archive entries authenticate and verify before replacement; the installer rechecks copied file hashes. Partial archives, changed verified files, unknown/overlapping/unapproved roots and linked destination ancestors fail without replacing the instance.
Disk admission precedes both verification and preparation. The state, vault, trash, key ring, external roots and disposable index are coordinated by a durable private installation record.

Old directories are retained; injected failures after old-directory moves, new-directory moves and index rebuild can roll back every root, including an external source. A rollback interrupted after displacing a restored directory can resume.
Normal startup refuses a pending restore while explicit recovery can take the same exclusive lock. Recovery completion is idempotent if interrupted before removal of the pending marker.

Restored paths are mapped in source settings, occurrences/absences, journal destinations, calendar snapshot paths, job metadata and internal projection/journal payloads; document bodies and file bytes are unchanged.
The new account epoch exceeds both source and destination epochs; old credentials are revoked, pending approvals expire and unfinished jobs are cancelled with an explicit retry reason.

The real CLI restores the captured document revision after 16 committed edits, rebuilds its searchable projection, restores a configured external source folder, and opens a protected calendar link with the restored Data Protection key ring. A previously recorded HMAC signature verifies under the restored ring.
CLI checks reject a running daemon, a wrong encryption key, invalid options, and replacement of the configured incoming root. Configured secrets and provider configuration are not overwritten.
notes: Initial test compilation needed namespace imports. Initial parameter casing in SQL tests and transformation updates was corrected; the final suite passes.

The initial concurrent-edit CLI fixture used an API-key actor, which correctly generated proposals instead of direct writes. It now uses an authorized session and asserts all 16 edits committed before checking that restore returns the captured revision.
The final run includes destination protection, pre-verification disk admission, actual lock retention and interrupted recovery completion checks.
No browser surface changed in this checkpoint. No production service, key, configuration, data root or external source was modified.
limitations: This is offline CLI qualification. Full live-daemon backup/restore under sustained edits, hardened systemd/Compose deployment and large-corpus resource qualification remain open.
Directory installation requires renameable destinations and writable parents; restoring directly onto external mount points still needs deployment-specific qualification or host-side path mapping.
Previous and prepared recovery folders are retained for operator review; automated cleanup, backup rotation, export and pre-migration integration remain open.
Only complete packages with a recoverable key ring are accepted by the CLI. No partial restore mode is provided.
Pending work is cancelled; operators must review and retry unfinished processing after restore.
